name: Rick Owens
why: Dark, draped clothing in leather, cashmere and jersey, made in the company's own factory in Italy.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles in 1994 by Rick Owens; the company now owns its Italian factory.

notes.ital: the California brutalist who bought his own Italian factory
notes.avant: glamour-brutalism with its own factory — the radical who industrialized
notes.weird: A complete parallel aesthetic, worked out over decades and internally consistent. Not strange within fashion so much as standing beside it.
